rule.statement: Parole evidence is permitted to prove a constructive trust between parties, even if it contradicts the Prevention of Frauds Ordinance.
rule.supporting_quote: In order to prove a constructive trust, is parole evidence permitted in view of the principles set out in Section 2 of the Prevention of Fraud Ordinance and Section 92 of the Evidence Ordinance? This question was discussed in the case of Dayawathi and Others Vs Gunasekara and Another [1991] 1 SLR 115.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 2 of the Prevention of Fraud Ordinance and Section 92 of the Evidence Ordinance
